Labrador - Autopsy of Silence (French: Labrador - Autopsie du silence) is a Canadian crime thriller film, directed by Rodrigue Jean and released in 2026. The film stars Christopher Angatookalook as Alupa Tulugak, an Inuk mechanic working on a cargo ship supplying remote communities in Labrador, who becomes a murder suspect after his lover Alex (Alexandre Landry), the ship's cook, turns up dead.
